acceptance_signals: One fresh task-owned temporary root is resolved inside the operating-system temporary directory before any staging write.
Git writes one allowlisted archive directly to a task-owned file without a shell binary pipeline.
The archive extracts into an initially empty source directory and contains the declared package metadata and distribution data paths.
Only current src/agentgov/change_scope.py and src/agentgov/governance_mcp.py are overlaid from the working tree, and both staged SHA-256 hashes match their source hashes.
Staged governance MCP reports Adapter 1.7.0, six base tools, eight form-capable tools, and agentgov_task_completion_record.
Task-excluded untracked schema-diagnostic and process-observer modules are absent from the staged source.
The attempt stops after the deterministic staging gate whether it passes or fails, with no repair, substitution, or retry.

No dependency download, virtual environment, package build, installation, consumer clone or write, MCP initialization, external model action, cleanup, Git operation, publication, release, or deployment occurs.

Starter evidence records only normalized counts, identities, hashes or hash-match results, boundaries, validation results, and remaining unknowns without raw output, source content, credentials, identities, or absolute paths.
Status, MCP guide, product requirement, dated log, and one new recovery record state the exact result without changing Kernel semantics or stable release identity.

Existing documentation tests, the complete Starter suite, task and repository governance, exact scope reconciliation, JSON parsing, privacy scans, and git diff check pass or truthfully report preserved excluded state.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-bbddb3ecc4524223bd3d64cb0daeae7d and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Create one fresh verified operating-system temporary root and stage the current AgentGov package source without using a PowerShell binary pipeline. Write the allowlisted Git archive directly to one task-owned file, extract it into an empty staging directory, overlay only the current change-scope and governance-MCP Adapter 1.7.0 source files, and verify exact hashes plus required package metadata and completion-tool templates. Record only normalized evidence and stop immediately after the staging gate. Do not download dependencies, create runtimes, build or install packages, clone or change a consumer, initialize MCP, invoke a model, clean retained task roots, modify Starter product source, or perform Git, publication, release, or deployment actions.

items: An incorrect archive output or extraction target could write outside the verified temporary root.
The archive could include unrelated working-copy content unless it is produced from committed HEAD with an explicit path allowlist.
The overlay could absorb unrelated untracked package modules unless only the two exact Adapter 1.7.0 files are copied and excluded-module absence is checked.
A successful staging result does not prove package build, installation, MCP discovery, consumer behavior, completion cards, or product value.
Retained temporary files consume local disk space because cleanup is outside this task.
Reviewed assumption: Git can write an archive directly to a file on this Windows host.
Reviewed assumption: The system tar reader can extract a file-backed archive.
Reviewed assumption: Current Adapter 1.7.0 requires only the two identified working-tree source overlays on top of committed package paths.
Reviewed unknown: Whether file-backed extraction succeeds on this host.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the resulting staged tree would later build and install successfully.
Reviewed unknown: Whether installed consumer completion behavior would work after a future separately admitted task.

title: Prove one binary-safe allowlisted source staging
